title: Berossus Dynasty 5 ("Arab" dynasty) at Babylon
summary: The fifth dynasty of Berossus: the Guti/Amorite "Arabs" rule Babylon from the fall of Akkad until Semiramis II.
description: CFAH-5 anchor point AP-42. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-42: Dynasty 5: “Arab” Dynasty: 1477–1232 B.C."
chronologies.note: From the fall of Akkad (AP-35) to Semiramis II taking Babylon (AP-15). Table 3 of CFAH-5 labels this dynasty "44" in its AP column (see open questions).

chronologies.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 85; Berossus, ap. Alexander Polyhistor, ap. Eusebius
chronologies.note: CFAH on this event prints "1477–1232 B.C." and does not print a length in years. The fragment prints 245 years and no BC year. Nothing is converted either way.
